name: audit-tool
description: Enterprise audit management and auditor scheduling platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test:unit --workspace=web
